title: Automated Discovery of Non-Standard Quantum Gate Decompositions with AI Research Agents

contributions.purpose: 用 AI agent 自动发现并验证非标准门分解
contributions.mechanism: 提议-验证闭环:agent 提候选电路→自写 Qiskit 脚本用 Operator.equiv() 校验酉等价(容全局相位)→不过则迭代
contributions.evaluation: Toffoli/SWAP/iSWAP 三门全部通过 equiv 验证
contributions.source_quote: The agent constructs a complete, self-contained Python script using the Qiskit library to verify the candidate... using the 'Operator.equiv()' method.

contributions.purpose: 声称获得硬件友好的替代分解
contributions.mechanism: 用 controlled-√X / CZ 等原生门替换 CNOT/T
contributions.evaluation: Toffoli 深度 11→5、两量子比特门 6→5;SWAP CNOT→CZ(深度 3→7);iSWAP SWAP-then-correct(两量子比特门 2→4)
contributions.source_quote: For the Toffoli gate, the agent identified a decomposition that reduces the two-qubit gate count from six to five and compresses the circuit depth from eleven to five by incorporating controlled-√X operations.

notes: 强数据红旗:所谓'novel'Toffoli 分解在验证脚本里直接命名为 'Novel_Toffoli_Barenco'——它就是标准 Barenco(1995)教科书构造(2 CNOT + 3 controlled-√X),并非新发现。SWAP'发现'仅是平凡恒等式 CNOT=H·CZ·H,且深度反而恶化 3→7。iSWAP'发现'用了更多门(两量子比特门 2→4),严格更差。故三例中唯一真降深度者(Toffoli)是被误标为发现的已知教科书结果,另两例为基变换/退化。本质是 AI 把教科书/平凡结果包装为'自动发现'。作者亦自承 'does not lie in inventing entirely new algebraic identities'。checklist:写作[D]、设计[C]。desk-reject。
